title: A Survey of Multilingual Reasoning in Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Surveying model performance disparities between high-resource and low-resource languages using multilingual reasoning benchmarks (e.g., MGSM, MSVAMP, XCSQA) and evaluating cross-lingual consistency, translation success rates, and zero-shot accuracy.

Evaluating the ability of models to adapt reasoning to cultural and contextual differences inherent to each language rather than applying English-centric logic, often assessed through native-language moral and commonsense reasoning tasks.
